operators.siteAndAppFinding: Official Agri Go Charge (formerly AgriSnellaad) publishes CPO ad-hoc QR prices separately from roaming: the QR payment page shows the current station price. Published categories are €0.49/kWh AC residential, €0.52/kWh AC public parking, €0.56/kWh DC 22–60 kW, and €0.65/kWh DC >=60 kW, with location/time-dependent connection fees. The app and PowerGoodies map confirm the Agri Go network, but do not expose an exact EVSE tariff mapping in the public HTML.
operators.nextInvestigation: Discover the QR payment-page URL/JSON endpoint for a representative set of exact Agri Go EVSEs, then reconcile EVSE IDs and current tariffs. Use the published categories only as validation, never as a bulk estimate; exclude the published roaming table and app/card provider surcharges.
